project_type: Full-stack community platform - Go (Gin) backend + React (React Router v7) frontend
build_system: Makefile at root, pnpm for web, Go build for backend
test_framework: Go test for backend, pnpm typecheck + pnpm lint for frontend
test_command: cd web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
verification_instructions: Run `pnpm typecheck` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web to confirm no TypeScript errors. Run `go build ./...` in root to confirm Go compiles.
setup_instructions: pnpm install in web/ directory (already done via pnpm-store)
environment_constraints: Network may be limited. pnpm store already present. No docker daemon needed for validation.
contribution_requirements: Keep PRs focused, support both en-US and zh-CN strings where applicable.
key_patterns: Frontend uses apiFetch() for API calls, LoadMore<T> for paginated lists, useSearchParams for URL state. Backend uses Gin handlers with ginx.WriteJSON for responses. TopicNode type in web/lib/api/types.ts is the canonical type.
directory_structure: Root: Go backend (internal/, cmd/, main.go). web/: React frontend (app/routes/ for pages, components/ for UI, lib/ for utilities).
